component.name: Fermix
component.summary: Set up Fermix and chat with it

description.p: Fermix is a personal assistant that runs as a background service on this computer. This window is where you set it up, talk to it, and see what it is doing.
The package carries the Fermix engine as well as the window. The engine runs as a service of your own account, started by your systemd user manager, and keeps running when the window is closed.

ul.li: Chat with Fermix, or call it and talk
Connect a model provider and the channels Fermix answers on
Start the service, keep it running in the background, and open the window at login
Run the doctor's checks and read the service's log
